request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Recolour only the red parts: the red body panels of the buggy become mismatched scrap metal, some panels dull gunmetal grey #6d7684 and some rusted iron #8a4a2a, and one small side panel hazard yellow with black diagonal stripes; the red wheel hubs become rusted iron; the driver's red cap becomes dull brown leather #955627. No red left. Keep the buggy's shape, the ram, wheels, exhaust and soot cloud, the driver, his goggles and olive skin, proportions, black outline and art style the same.
